title: Entry envelope
description: One shape for all four entries (T-t6-02). kind says which entry produced it; nothing downstream branches on it. Identity, correlation, budget ceiling and idempotency key are required on every envelope because the platform applies those concerns rather than the caller requesting them (F-b4-01).

kind.description: human: a person acts. event: something happened. schedule: a recurrence rule fired. external: another system or agent submitted work.

actor.description: Every action names an actor, including delegated agent actors, and the delegation chain is explicit (F-b4-03).

intent.description: What to run and why. workflow_ref is the declared unit of work; document_ref points at a longer declaration when one exists.

correlation.description: Correlation rides on explicit attributes set at entry, never on trace parentage (F-b4-06).

budget.description: Exceeding the ceiling terminates the unit, not the platform; on_exceed is a const so no caller can opt out (F-b4-02).

idempotency_key.description: Every externally-triggered action is safe to replay (F-b4-08). Same key plus same body is a no-op; same key plus a different body is a conflict.

payload.description: Entry-specific body. Nothing downstream of intake parses it by entry kind.
